bias.zh: 下降趋势 · 超卖反弹，仍低于 5 日均线

read.en: Nvidia rose 2.9% on Nov 11 to $173.73, trading $170.77–177.54 on heavy volume (1.82x the 20-day average). It is below the 5-day ($177.9), 10-day ($191.7), 30-day ($213.1), 100-day ($213.0) and 200-day ($204.5), all falling. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12, below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 13 ($189.84), and RSI is 28.7, oversold.
read.zh: 英伟达 11月11日上涨 2.9%，收于 $173.73，盘中区间 $170.77–177.54，成交量放大（20 日均量的 1.82 倍）。股价位于 5 日（$177.9）、10 日（$191.7）、30 日（$213.1）、100 日（$213.0）和 200 日均线（$204.5）下方，均在下行。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月13日起看空（$189.84），RSI 为 28.7，处于超卖区。

read.en: The bounce reclaimed the $170.2 Nov 9 low and the $174.65 Nov 10 high is now just above the close; the $177.54 high stalled under the 5-day and the $176.8–177.6 old lows. Resistance is $176.8–177.9, then $179.9–181.6 (Nov 9 high, Nov 5 low and close) and $189.8 (SAR). Support is $170.2–170.8 (Nov 9 and Nov 11 lows), then $164.3–165.9 (52-week low, Nov 10 low) and $160. A close above $177.9 would target $180–182; below $170.2, $164–166.
